items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25

ctx.x: You said your phone would ring one.

No, I was talking about the different people when they found where Punch was living at. They would ring, he, he roomed with me, you know. And I said different women, white and colored would call it. I had to put a very rich woman out of my home. He can tell you about his, uh, singing. She came there with her chauffeur and all. And Punch can tell you I had to ask her out. And she wanted Punch to sing, and just, because at that time I wasn't broad enough to understand, but she just wanted to hear him sing. She said…
Did you have a phonograph in those days?
